children: Oil edges lower as supply surplus prospects offset Middle East tensions. "According to the latest reports, Saudi Arabia has increased production to 10.5 million barrels per day," FxPro'sAlex Kuptsikevich says in an email. "There are also reports of a significant increase in production in Iraq and Kuwait," the chief market analyst adds. However, oil-price losses may be limited by Mideast tensions. On Tuesday, Iran said its drones hit a U.S. radar base in Bahrain. U.S. Central Command said on X that the drones were intercepted "without any damage to U.S. equipment or injury to American personnel." Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.2% lower at $85.86 per barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
